_label: TEACHING VALUES ONLY - quoted from the owner's course digests and the clinmicro-judgment card so the tools can be demonstrated. NOT a lab SOP: replace with your lab's specimen-acceptance and culture-interpretation SOP.

sputum-card-fork5._src: clinmicro-judgment card FORK 5 + FORK 7 LRTI: accept SEC<10 and PMN>25/LPF; reject SEC>25/LPF; 10-25 borderline

sputum-508304._src: 508304 lecture digest §2 sputum quality (Bartlett/Q-score): accept PMN>25 and SEC<10/LPF; reject SEC>10/LPF

bands.label: 1e3-1e4
bands.action: May be normal flora -> Gram + ID; interpret by site/symptoms/single vs mixed

urine-509402._src: 509402 digest §4 colony-count table (loop 0.001 mL, colonies x 1,000) + '>=1e5 pure/predominant'; card FORK 3
urine-509402._note: Sources differ on mixed growth: card iron rule #1 and trap 1 say '>=3 species', 509402 §4 and the card FORK 3 table say '>3'. Card FORK 3 says a symptomatic single uropathogen can be significant from 1e2-1e3 CFU/mL; 1000 here is a teaching pick. Your SOP decides both.

bands.label: >=1e4
bands.action: Meets the VAP quantitative threshold -> ID + AST

bal-508304._src: 508304 digest §2 BAL quantitative culture (0.01 mL loop; 100 colonies = 1e4 CFU/mL; VAP >= 1e4 CFU/mL); card FORK 7
